cohort: 1631 healthy pregnant women participated, from whom 30 women who developed PE (cases) were compared with 146 randomly selected healthy pregnant women (controls).
finding: The development of PE in late pregnancy was associated with increased levels of the urine plasminogen-plasmin/creatinine ratio (OR=2.35), but increased urinary albumin levels revealed stronger associations with PE development (OR=14.04 from gestational week 33).
cross-section timing: Longitudinally six times during pregnancy, with specific associations noted from gestational week 33, week 33-35, and after gestational week 36.
